caseDataStatus: Synthetic, non-user test inputs with fixed public location coordinates selected to exercise reproducible IANA timezone and chart calculations.
scope: End-to-end birth-input normalization and LIFE chart-pipeline comparison for geocentric tropical planetary longitude/latitude only. House cusps, ascendant, ayanamsa, sidereal positions, D1 placements, and D2-D60 birth-chart placements are not independently established by the linked JPL fixtures.

reference.quantityConvention: Geocentric apparent ecliptic-of-date tropical longitude and latitude, airless observer centered at Earth geocenter.
reference.toleranceRationale: Use the existing fixed-fixture allowance for published decimal rounding and small time-scale/frame realization differences; no tolerance is assigned to unsupported outputs.

boundaryCoverage.mappingScope: Synthetic sidereal-longitude probes 1e-7 degrees on both sides of every D2-D60 segment boundary across all source signs.
boundaryCoverage.natalBirthBoundaryReference: Unavailable: no independently calculated sidereal planetary positions and matching varga placements near birth-chart segment boundaries.

cases.zodiac: sidereal (Lahiri) for LIFE chart; JPL comparison quantities are tropical
cases.houseSystemConvention: Placidus is recorded in LIFE output; no independent house reference is available.

ephemeris.lifeData: checked-in Swiss Ephemeris assets; data/ephemeris-manifest.json v1
ephemeris.lifeFlags: Swiss Ephemeris | Speed; sidereal output additionally sets Sidereal
ephemeris.utcToUtConvention: Resolved UTC instant is supplied to calc_ut as UT1 approximation without DUT1 correction; Swiss applies Delta T internally.
